"GREEN EMPIRE: UNDERGROUND WAR

Create a mobile strategy and base-building game inspired by Clash of Clans, Weed Firm and Breaking Bad.

The gameplay should follow the base-building, upgrading, resource management and attacking mechanics of Clash of Clans, but with an original underground cannabis empire theme.

1. VISUAL STYLE

- 2.5D isometric cartoon graphics.
- Angled top-down camera.
- Detailed miniature buildings and characters.
- Colourful but slightly gritty Breaking Bad-inspired atmosphere.
- Animated workers, vehicles and buildings.
- Mobile-friendly interface.

The game should feel like Clash of Clans, NOT a first-person game or a traditional 3D simulator.

2. BUILD YOUR EMPIRE

Start with a small abandoned property and gradually construct an enormous underground empire.

Buildings include:

- Grow houses.
- Greenhouses.
- Processing laboratories.
- Storage warehouses.
- Packaging facilities.
- Money management buildings.
- Security buildings.
- Worker accommodation.
- Research laboratories.
- Underground headquarters.

Every building can be upgraded through multiple levels, visually changing as it develops.

3. RESOURCES

Introduce several resources:

- Cash: used for construction and upgrades.
- Cannabis: produced by growing facilities.
- Chemicals: used for fictional production and research mechanics.
- Supplies: required for construction and maintenance.
- Reputation: unlocks new opportunities and progression.

Resources should be collected from buildings and stored in dedicated storage facilities.

4. WORKERS AND CHARACTERS

Workers automatically manage different buildings.

Introduce unique characters with different abilities:

- The Grower: improves production.
- The Chemist: improves research.
- The Dealer: improves business income.
- The Engineer: speeds up construction.
- The Enforcer: improves base defence.

Characters can be upgraded and assigned to buildings.

5. ATTACK AND DEFENCE

Make this a major part of the game, similar to Clash of Clans.

Players can:

- Scout rival bases.
- Deploy units.
- Attack enemy buildings.
- Steal resources.
- Earn trophies and reputation.
- Defend their own base against attacks.

Create different unit types with unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses.

Include a defensive system with guards, security cameras, reinforced buildings and automated defences.

6. RESEARCH AND UPGRADES

Create a research laboratory where players unlock:

- Better production equipment.
- Improved resource storage.
- Stronger defensive units.
- Faster construction.
- New building types.
- Advanced technologies.

Use a progression tree with multiple unlockable levels.

7. POLICE HEAT SYSTEM

As your empire grows, so does the attention it attracts.

Include:

- Police investigations.
- Random raids.
- Suspicion levels.
- Security upgrades.
- Risk management.
- Temporary building shutdowns.

Players must balance expansion and risk.

8. PROGRESSION

Introduce headquarters levels, similar to Town Hall in Clash of Clans.

Each headquarters upgrade unlocks new buildings, units, research and territory.

Progression:

1. Street Hustler.
2. Small-Time Operator.
3. Local Kingpin.
4. Underground Boss.
5. Regional Empire.
6. National Syndicate.
7. Underground Legend.

9. MULTIPLAYER SYSTEM

If supported, introduce:

- Player-versus-player attacks.
- Leaderboards.
- Alliances or criminal syndicates.
- Alliance wars.
- Shared rewards.
- Weekly competitions.

If real multiplayer is not supported, create AI-controlled rival bases that players can attack.

10. GAMEPLAY REQUIREMENTS

The game must have:

- A fully interactive base.
- Building placement and movement.
- Construction timers.
- Upgrade timers.
- Resource collection.
- Worker management.
- Unit training.
- Attack and defence mechanics.
- A working progression system.
- Save/load functionality.

Start by building the core game with one base, five resource/building types, a headquarters, upgrade mechanics and a basic attack system.

Make it polished, addictive and expandable.

The goal is to create a Clash of Clans-style strategy game with the underground criminal atmosphere of Breaking Bad and the business theme of Weed Firm.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile strategy/base-building game called “GREEN EMPIRE: UNDERGROUND WAR” in the existing project.
- Deliver an interactive base, progression, simulated rival competition, and persistent browser saves.

## Requirements
- 2.5D angled isometric cartoon presentation, mobile-friendly UI, animated details.
- Interactive building placement/movement, construction and upgrade timers, resource collection, worker management, training, attack/defence, progression, and save/load.
- Include AI rival bases if real multiplayer is unavailable.
- Capture screenshots for checks as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

- Implemented as standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript with a canvas-rendered isometric map.
- Rivals are simulated AI crews; no real multiplayer integration.
- Game state is persisted in browser `localStorage`.
